name: Candlestick Chart
description: Interactive OHLC candlestick chart with time ranges, pinning and drag-to-measure.
summary: A responsive SVG candlestick chart drawn in pixel space from a ResizeObserver, so wicks and labels stay crisp at any width. Candles grow from their midpoints and volume bars rise from the baseline through scoped useGSAP timelines that only animate scaleY and opacity. Range tabs replay the entrance on a new window, hovering or the arrow keys snap a crosshair to the nearest session, clicking or Enter pins a candle, and dragging or Shift with the arrow keys measures the percentage change between two sessions.
highlights: Range tabs that slice the series and replay the staggered entrance
Click or Enter to pin a candle with an onCandleSelect callback
Drag or Shift with the arrow keys to measure change between two sessions
Crosshair with a price tag and a live price and change header
Scoped useGSAP animations reverted on unmount, range and data changes
anatomy: <div role="group"> (Focusable plot area with fixed height)
<svg> (Grid, candles, volume band, measurement band and crosshair)
(Announcements for inspected, pinned and measured candles)

physics.description: Candle bodies and wicks scale up from their midpoint while volume bars rise from the chart floor, staggered left to right. Changing the range replays the sequence.

accessibility.aria: The plot area uses aria-roledescription="candlestick chart" and an aria-label that lists the keyboard controls. Range buttons expose aria-pressed. A polite live region announces inspected, pinned and measured candles.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Entrance animations are skipped through gsap.matchMedia when prefers-reduced-motion is set, and candle dimming has no transition.

keyboard.description: Move between the range buttons and the plot area.
Inspect the previous or next candle.
Jump to the first or latest candle.
Measure the change from the current candle to the next one reached.
Pin or unpin the inspected candle.
Clear the pin, measurement and inspection.

recommended: Stock, crypto and commodity price history in dashboards
Trading summaries and portfolio detail pages
bestPractices: Memoize the data array so the entrance animation only replays when the data or range changes.
Keep sessions to a few hundred candles; aggregate longer ranges into weekly or monthly candles.
Use unique ISO date strings so each candle has a stable key.
Pass ranges={[]} to hide the range tabs.
Set valuePrefix to match the quote currency.

props.name: showVolume
props.description: Show the volume band when the data includes volume.

props.name: ranges
